excluded_candidates.reason: This describes the auxiliary perturbation GNN over STRING v12 rather than a direct source-to-model input route in the frozen carrier taxonomy; the route is graph/module-level and the graph carrier is not one of the frozen positive families.
This is a file-handling and preprocessing workflow around an uploaded AnnData object, not a distinct biological source object carried directly into the focal model as an input route.
